title: Rigaudon
identity: The catalog lists Paul Lacome’s Rigaudon, edition Southern SS290, arranged for alto saxophone and piano by Albert Andraud and dedicated to Larry Teal. Search results also surfaced a tenor edition; specific instrumentation and arrangement details should be confirmed against the held edition.

evidence.claim: Catalog lead identifies Andraud arrangement, Southern SS290, dedication.
Search lead for separate tenor edition.

Music8’s product page identifies the Southern Music alto edition, Paul Lacome, arrangement by Albert J. Andraud, and advertises a sample PDF. Direct page retrieval failed, so notation was not accessed.

Hal Leonard’s current arranger catalog confirms Rigaudon by Paul Lacome arranged by Albert Andraud for tenor saxophone, with Southern Music item SS290; other retailers identify the alto edition separately.

review_focus: Review the dance movement’s articulation and piano balance in the specific alto edition; no technique demands independently verified.
